dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Alright, time to show off how fast I can run! I'm gonna go have a blast, then come back, calm down, and focus on running my fruit stall.

choices.text: Don't forget to grab some water.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. Last thing you'd want is to get too absorbed in having fun, then suddenly realize you're starving 'cause you haven't eaten anything for hours...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Funnily enough, Paimon can think of someone else with a bad habit of getting so into things that they forget to eat... No matter how busy you are, nothing's more important than staying well-fed, hydrated, and healthy!

choices.text: Wow, so you know someone like that too, huh?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: No need to worry about me, guys! I do a lot of long-distance running, so I always make sure to bring some food and water with me. This time is no exception!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Varesa steps into the Movie Masterpieces play zone and dives right in...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How was it? Did you get through all the levels?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: It... was... amazing! Not only did I get a super high score, but I also checked up on every homage to the original films, and even recreated several iconic scenes starring comic book superheroes!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I'll focus on doing business this time round, but if there's ever another event like this, please let me know as early as possible. I want in!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! Y'know what, we should let you design the levels. Paimon's sure all the fans will be thrilled!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: That would be great! Anyway, back to business — time to focus on my fruit stall. I'm gonna make a name for my orchard in Fontaine.

choices.text: We'll let you know, for sure!
Ooh, I wonder who that is? They need to fix that habit, that's for sure!
And snacks to keep your energy up.
